body:
Design question: this re-lists a diff.head as a retention parent even
when it's already reachable from the current tip (observed on the
threads ref: 43bc41e appears as parent twice). SPEC.md §5.2 says MUST
per distinct head, so this is compliant — but a reachability check
before adding the parent would keep the graph tidier. Is the check worth
its cost, and should the spec say MAY skip already-reachable heads?
